display.name: Market Making
display.description:
no signal, no view. we quote both sides of btc eth and sol continuously and earn the spread and the rebates.

the only thing that moves our quotes is what we're already holding. get long and the offers tighten toward index while the bids back off, so the book works its way back to flat instead of digging in. flat book, symmetric quotes.

exit sits at 1.10x, basically par. a book like this gets marked constantly and shouldn't wander far from what it owes — so if it does, that's worth knowing.
display._x_note: X linking needs a real OAuth click-through per vault (getXChallenge -> authorize on X -> setVaultXConnection). Not automatable; see README.
